altersvorsorge.Name: Retirement Planning
altersvorsorge.Headline: Secure your financial future
altersvorsorge.Einleitung Hero: Discover a range of retirement planning options that help you build a secure financial future and enjoy your retirement.
altersvorsorge.Thema: A secure financial future: our retirement planning options
altersvorsorge.Thema Richtext: A secure financial future is an important goal you'll want to achieve. A retirement insurance policy gives you the opportunity to save systematically for your pension and build up a financial cushion for retirement. You can choose between various retirement products, such as the Riester Pension or the Basic Pension (Rürup). These policies offer you state subsidies and give you long-term financial security in old age.
altersvorsorge.FAQ Frage 2: What options are there for retirement planning?
altersvorsorge.FAQ Frage 3: When should you start planning for retirement?
altersvorsorge.FAQ Frage 4: What risks are involved in retirement planning?
altersvorsorge.FAQ Antwort 1: Retirement planning means securing your finances for retirement. It's about building up assets or taking out insurance products during your working life so that you have a sufficient income in old age and can maintain your standard of living.
altersvorsorge.FAQ Antwort 2: There are various ways to plan for retirement, e.g. the statutory pension insurance, company pension schemes, private pension insurance, the Riester Pension, or investments in investment funds or property. Each option has different advantages and disadvantages, depending on your individual needs and financial circumstances.
altersvorsorge.FAQ Antwort 3: It's advisable to start planning for retirement early, ideally when you're still young. The earlier you start, the longer you have to build up capital and benefit from the effects of compound interest. However, it's never too late to start planning for retirement.
altersvorsorge.FAQ Antwort 4: There are various risks to consider in retirement planning, e.g. inflation, investment losses, rising life expectancy or changes in legislation. It's important to take these risks into account when planning for retirement and, where appropriate, to diversify your investments broadly.

autoversicherung.Name: Car Insurance
autoversicherung.Headline: Protect your vehicle and yourself
autoversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out how car insurance can protect both your vehicle and yourself against financial risks and unforeseen damage.
autoversicherung.Thema: All-round protection for your vehicle and your safety
autoversicherung.Thema Richtext: Car insurance is essential to give both your vehicle and yourself comprehensive protection. Motor third-party liability insurance (Kfz-Haftpflicht) covers you against third-party claims for damages after an accident. Partial cover (Teilkasko) and fully comprehensive cover (Vollkasko) offer additional protection for damage to your own vehicle, e.g. from theft, storm damage or vandalism. It's important to check your insurance policies carefully and adjust the sums insured to suit your needs. You should also consider accident insurance, which provides financial benefits in the event of injury or disability following an accident. Comprehensive protection for your vehicle and yourself gives you the reassuring feeling of being well protected on the road.
autoversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: How is the premium for car insurance calculated?
autoversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Can I switch my car insurance?
autoversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: What is the difference between liability and comprehensive (Kasko) insurance?
autoversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Car insurance usually covers damage to your own vehicle as well as liability claims against the driver in the event of an accident. Depending on the policy, further benefits such as theft protection or comprehensive (Kasko) cover may also be included.
autoversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: The premium for car insurance is usually calculated on the basis of various factors, such as the driver's age and gender, the type of vehicle, the no-claims class (Schadenfreiheitsklasse) and annual mileage.
autoversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Yes, in most cases it is possible to switch your car insurance. However, you should bear in mind notice periods and any minimum contract terms. Comparing offers from different insurers usually lets you switch to a cheaper tariff.
autoversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Liability insurance covers damage you cause to other people with your vehicle. Comprehensive (Kasko) insurance, on the other hand, covers damage to your own vehicle caused by accidents, theft or vandalism. Kasko insurance can be divided into partial cover (Teilkasko) and fully comprehensive cover (Vollkasko).

basisrente.Name: Basic Pension (Rürup)
basisrente.Headline: Tax-advantaged retirement provision
basisrente.Einleitung Hero: Get to know the tax-advantaged Basic Pension, which gives you tax benefits and solid retirement provision.
basisrente.Thema: Tax-advantaged retirement provision: a financial advantage for your pension
basisrente.Thema Richtext: Tax-advantaged retirement provision gives you the opportunity to save for your pension through targeted tax incentives. A private pension insurance policy, a company pension scheme or a direct insurance policy (Direktversicherung) are examples of tax-advantaged retirement products. Thanks to the tax relief, you can reduce your taxable income while saving for your pension at the same time. By taking advantage of the tax benefits, you create a solid financial foundation for your retirement.
basisrente.FAQ Frage 2: What are the advantages of the Basic Pension?
basisrente.FAQ Frage 3: Who can benefit from the Basic Pension?
basisrente.FAQ Frage 4: Are there any restrictions with the Basic Pension?
basisrente.FAQ Antwort 1: The Basic Pension (Basisrente), also known as the Rürup Pension, is a state-subsidised private pension in Germany. It is aimed in particular at self-employed people and high earners. With the Basic Pension, contributions can be claimed to reduce your tax bill, and the benefits are taxed in retirement.
basisrente.FAQ Antwort 2: The Basic Pension offers several advantages. Firstly, contributions to the Basic Pension can be claimed to reduce your tax, which provides long-term tax relief. Secondly, the Basic Pension is protected from Hartz IV and therefore provides security in old age.
basisrente.FAQ Antwort 3: Self-employed people, freelancers and high earners in particular can benefit from the Basic Pension. The exact requirements vary depending on the country and legislation.
basisrente.FAQ Antwort 4: Yes, there are certain rules and restrictions with the Basic Pension. These include, for example, certain minimum contributions, a start phase for pension payments laid down by the state, and the obligation to pay tax on the Basic Pension benefits in retirement. In addition, the Basic Pension cannot be inherited, so no survivors' benefits are paid in the event of early death.

bauherrenhaftpflicht.Name: Builder's Liability Insurance
bauherrenhaftpflicht.Headline: Protection during your building project
bauherrenhaftpflicht.Einleitung Hero: Find out about builder's liability insurance (Bauherrenhaftpflicht), which protects you against financial risks and liability claims during your building project.
bauherrenhaftpflicht.Thema: Security from start to finish: our building project insurance
bauherrenhaftpflicht.Thema Richtext: When you carry out a building project, specific insurance policies are important to protect you against the associated risks. Contractors' all-risk insurance (Bauleistungsversicherung) provides financial protection for damage to the building during the construction phase, e.g. from fire, theft or natural disasters. Builder's liability insurance is also very important, as it protects you against liability claims that may arise on your building plot during the construction phase. In addition, you might also consider a construction warranty insurance policy to protect yourself against defects in the building after the project has been completed. With the right insurance cover, you minimise the financial risks during your building project and can complete it successfully.
bauherrenhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 2: Why is builder's liability insurance important?
bauherrenhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 3: Does builder's liability insurance also apply to construction companies?
bauherrenhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 4: How long does builder's liability insurance last?
bauherrenhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 1: Builder's liability insurance is an insurance policy that protects people commissioning a building project against third-party claims for damages during the construction phase. It covers personal injury or property damage that may occur on the building site or in connection with the building project.
bauherrenhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 2: Builder's liability insurance is important because building projects involve a range of risks. Accidents, damage to neighbouring properties or injuries to people can have considerable financial consequences. Builder's liability insurance provides protection against such risks.
bauherrenhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 3: No, builder's liability insurance does not usually apply to construction companies or building tradespeople. It is aimed specifically at the person commissioning the build, i.e. the owner of the building project.
bauherrenhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 4: The duration of builder's liability insurance is usually limited to the period of the building project. As soon as the building project has been completed or the building has been moved into, the insurance cover usually ends as well. It's important to check the policy terms and conditions to find out the exact period of cover.

bausparen.Name: Building Society Savings (Bausparen)
bausparen.Headline: Secure your dream home
bausparen.Einleitung Hero: Find out how the right insurance solutions can protect your dream home, both during construction and once it's finished.
bausparen.Thema: Protection for your dream home: our tailored solutions
bausparen.Thema Richtext: Buying or building your own home is a big step in life and requires careful planning and protection. Construction financing is often necessary to make the project happen. It's important to find out about the various financing options and interest rates and to find a tailored financing solution. Advice on construction financing can help you choose the best financing option for your dream home and make the process run smoothly. With careful financial planning and protection, you lay a solid foundation for your dream home.
bausparen.FAQ Frage 2: What are the advantages of Bausparen?
bausparen.FAQ Frage 3: Is there a minimum term for a building savings contract?
bausparen.FAQ Frage 4: Can you use the savings early?
bausparen.FAQ Antwort 1: Bausparen is a long-term form of saving and financing that enables you to buy or build your own home. You take out a building savings contract (Bausparvertrag) and regularly save a fixed amount. After a savings phase, you can take out a low-interest building savings loan (Bauspardarlehen).
bausparen.FAQ Antwort 2: Bausparen offers several advantages. Firstly, it enables long-term saving and is a safe form of investment. Secondly, a building savings contract gives you the opportunity to obtain a low-cost loan for building or buying a property. You can also benefit from state subsidies such as the housing construction premium (Wohnungsbauprämie) or the employee savings allowance (Arbeitnehmer-Sparzulage).
bausparen.FAQ Antwort 3: Yes, there is usually a minimum term for a building savings contract. This varies depending on the provider, but is often several years. During this time, the balance is built up and your savings performance is assessed before you can apply for the building savings loan.
bausparen.FAQ Antwort 4: Yes, under certain conditions the savings can be used early. This may be possible, for example, if the contract is terminated early or for renovation work on existing properties. However, the exact conditions and options vary depending on the provider and the contract.

berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.Name: Occupational Disability Insurance
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.Headline: Protection if you're unable to work
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out how occupational disability insurance gives you financial protection if you become unable to work due to illness or an accident.
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.Thema: Protection if you're unable to work: secure your financial stability
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.Thema Richtext: Occupational disability insurance gives you financial support if you can no longer work in your profession due to illness or an accident. It pays you a monthly pension to cover your living costs. This kind of insurance is particularly important because the statutory reduced earning capacity pension (Erwerbsminderungsrente) is often not enough to maintain your usual standard of living. With occupational disability insurance, you protect your livelihood and your financial future.
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: When should you take out occupational disability insurance?
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: What is the difference between occupational disability insurance and general disability insurance (Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung)?
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Occupational disability insurance is an insurance policy that protects the insured person financially if they can no longer work in their previous occupation due to illness or an accident. In this case, it pays out a monthly pension to compensate for the loss of income.
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: The definition of occupational disability can vary depending on the insurance contract. As a rule, occupational disability applies if, for health reasons, the insured person can permanently carry out less than 50% of their professional activity. However, the exact definition depends on the policy terms and conditions.
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: It's advisable to take out occupational disability insurance as early as possible, ideally when you're still young and in good health. The older you are, or the more health risks you have, the higher the premiums may be, or there may be exclusions or limitations on benefits.
berufsunfahigkeitsversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Occupational disability insurance covers the loss of your ability to work in your own occupation, whereas general disability insurance (Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung) covers the loss of your ability to do any kind of paid work. So with general disability insurance, it's not just your previous occupation that is taken into account, but any kind of gainful employment. The scope of benefits and the conditions can vary from insurer to insurer.

feuerrohbauversicherung.Name: Fire Insurance for Buildings Under Construction (Feuerrohbauversicherung)
feuerrohbauversicherung.Headline: Security during your building project
feuerrohbauversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out about fire insurance for buildings under construction (Feuerrohbauversicherung) and how it protects you against possible damage from fire or other risks during your building project.
feuerrohbauversicherung.Thema: Security during the construction phase: our protection solutions
feuerrohbauversicherung.Thema Richtext: When you carry out a building project, special insurance policies are important to protect you during the construction process. Fire insurance for buildings under construction provides financial protection for damage to the building shell during the construction phase, e.g. from fire or lightning strikes. In addition, you might consider builder's liability insurance, which protects you against third-party liability claims that may arise on your building plot during the construction phase. With the right insurance cover, you minimise the financial risks during your building project and can complete it successfully.
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Frage 1: What is fire insurance for buildings under construction?
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Why is fire insurance for buildings under construction important?
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Does fire insurance for buildings under construction also apply to construction companies?
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: What damage is covered by fire insurance for buildings under construction?
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Fire insurance for buildings under construction is an insurance policy that applies during the construction phase of a building. It covers damage caused by fire, lightning and explosions to the unfinished building. Cover usually lasts until the building is completed.
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Fire insurance for buildings under construction is important because there is an increased risk of fire and explosion during the construction phase of a building. The insurance covers the costs of any damage that may result from these risks.
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: No, fire insurance for buildings under construction does not usually apply to construction companies or building tradespeople. It is aimed specifically at the person commissioning the build or the owner of the building.
feuerrohbauversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Fire insurance for buildings under construction covers damage caused by fire, lightning and explosions to the unfinished building. This includes, for example, fire- or lightning-related damage to materials, building components or construction equipment.

fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.Name: Unit-Linked Life Insurance
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.Headline: Combine insurance cover with investment opportunities
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Discover the advantages of insurance solutions that not only offer you protection but also investment opportunities to build wealth and secure your financial future.
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.Thema: Invest in your future: insurance cover with return potential
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.Thema Richtext: Unit-linked life insurance gives you the opportunity to combine insurance cover with long-term investment opportunities. With unit-linked life insurance, part of your premiums is invested in selected investment funds, allowing you to benefit from the opportunities offered by the capital markets. At the same time, you enjoy the protection of a life insurance policy. This kind of insurance enables you to build up your wealth over the long term and benefit from potential returns.
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: What are the advantages of unit-linked life insurance?
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: What are the risks of unit-linked life insurance?
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Is unit-linked life insurance suitable for everyone?
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Unit-linked life insurance combines traditional life insurance with an investment component. The premiums are invested in investment funds, so the amount of the later payout depends on the performance of the funds.
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Unit-linked life insurance offers the chance of higher returns compared with traditional life insurance, as the capital is invested in investment funds. There is also often the option to choose between different funds and investment strategies.
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Unit-linked life insurance involves investment risks, as the value of the investments can fluctuate. If the funds perform poorly, this can lead to a lower payout. In addition, there may be costs for administration, taking out the policy and risk cover.
fondsgebundene-lebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Unit-linked life insurance is particularly suitable for people who are willing to take risks when investing and are looking for the chance of higher returns. It's important to consider your own investment goals, risk appetite and investment knowledge before deciding on unit-linked life insurance.

fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.Name: Unit-Linked Pension Insurance
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.Headline: Flexible wealth building for your retirement
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out about flexible insurance solutions that help you build wealth and create a solid financial basis for your retirement.
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.Thema: Flexible wealth building for your retirement: a secure financial future
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.Thema Richtext: Flexible wealth building for your retirement gives you the opportunity to build up your assets in a targeted way and provide for your retirement. A private pension insurance policy or an endowment life insurance policy (Kapitallebensversicherung) offers you flexible ways to save up assets while also benefiting from insurance cover. You can adjust the premiums and term individually to your needs and have the flexibility to receive lump sums or a lifelong pension. Flexible wealth building gives you the freedom to actively shape your retirement and achieve financial independence in old age.
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: What are the advantages of unit-linked pension insurance?
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: What are the risks of unit-linked pension insurance?
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Is unit-linked pension insurance suitable for everyone?
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Unit-linked pension insurance is a pension insurance policy in which the premiums are invested in investment funds. The accumulated capital is used in retirement to pay out a lifelong pension.
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Unit-linked pension insurance offers the chance of higher returns compared with traditional pension insurance, as the capital is invested in investment funds. There is also often the option to choose between different funds and investment strategies.
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Unit-linked pension insurance involves investment risks, as the value of the investments can fluctuate. If the funds perform poorly, this can lead to a lower payout. In addition, there may be costs for administration, taking out the policy and risk cover.
fondsgebundene-rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Unit-linked pension insurance is particularly suitable for people who are willing to take risks when investing and are looking for the chance of higher returns. It's important to consider your own investment goals, risk appetite and investment knowledge before deciding on unit-linked pension insurance.

gebaudeversicherung.Name: Buildings Insurance
gebaudeversicherung.Headline: Protection for your property
gebaudeversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out about the various insurance options that help you protect your property against damage from accidents, theft or other risks.
gebaudeversicherung.Thema: Security for your property: rely on our protection
gebaudeversicherung.Thema Richtext: Property can be a significant investment, and it's important to protect it accordingly. Buildings insurance protects your property against damage from fire, storms, escaping mains water or other insured perils. In addition to buildings insurance, home contents insurance makes sense to protect your valuables in the house against theft or damage. If you rent out property, landlord's liability insurance is recommended to protect you against liability claims from tenants or third parties. With the right insurance cover, you can protect your property effectively and guard against potential financial risks.
gebaudeversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: What damage is covered by buildings insurance?
gebaudeversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: What is the difference between buildings insurance and home contents insurance?
gebaudeversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Is buildings insurance required by law?
gebaudeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Buildings insurance is an insurance policy that covers damage to a building. It protects owners against financial losses that can result from risks such as fire, storms, escaping mains water, hail or natural hazards (Elementarschäden).
gebaudeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Buildings insurance usually covers damage to the building itself, e.g. from fire, lightning, storms, hail, escaping mains water or natural disasters such as floods or earthquakes. Depending on the policy, further risks such as glass breakage or natural hazards (Elementarschäden) may also be covered.
gebaudeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: While buildings insurance protects the building itself, home contents insurance covers your movable household contents (furniture, electrical appliances, clothing, etc.). Buildings insurance focuses on structural damage to the building, whereas home contents insurance protects what's inside the building.
gebaudeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Buildings insurance is not required by law in most countries. However, in certain cases, such as when financing through a bank or mortgage lender, it may be a contractual requirement.

gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.Name: Statutory Health Insurance (GKV)
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.Headline: Essential protection for your health
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out about the benefits of statutory health insurance, which gives you essential protection for your health.
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.Thema: Essential cover for your health: our insurance solutions
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.Thema Richtext: Statutory health insurance provides essential insurance cover for your health. It covers the costs of medical treatment and medicines. To meet your individual needs, you can take out supplementary health insurance in addition to your statutory health insurance. This gives you additional benefits such as better accommodation in hospital or alternative therapies.
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Who is insured under statutory health insurance?
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Which benefits are covered by statutory health insurance?
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: How much are statutory health insurance contributions?
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Statutory health insurance is a state-regulated form of health insurance that exists in many countries. It provides basic care for those insured and includes medical services such as doctor's appointments, medicines, hospital stays and preventive check-ups.
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: As a rule, statutory health insurance covers everyone who meets certain requirements. These include, for example, employees with a certain income, family members of insured persons and self-employed people within a certain income threshold. The exact requirements vary from country to country.
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: The benefits of statutory health insurance are set out by law and include basic medical care. This covers medical treatment, medicines, hospital stays, preventive check-ups and certain rehabilitation measures.
gesetzliche-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Contributions to statutory health insurance are generally based on income. The exact contribution rates and calculations vary depending on the country and legislation. Employees and employers often share the contributions to statutory health insurance.

gewerbeversicherung.Name: Business Insurance
gewerbeversicherung.Headline: Protect your business all round
gewerbeversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out about the various insurance solutions that can comprehensively protect your business and safeguard you against financial risks.
gewerbeversicherung.Thema: Security for your business: all-round protection for your success
gewerbeversicherung.Thema Richtext: As a business owner, you are responsible for your company, your employees and your customers. Comprehensive business insurance is therefore essential. It protects you against financial losses that can arise from business interruptions, liability claims, property damage or other operational risks. Business liability insurance covers damage caused to third parties in the course of your business activities. Business interruption insurance provides financial support if your company is temporarily unable to operate, e.g. due to fire damage or natural disasters. By protecting your business all round, you can make sure you safeguard your company's success and minimise any financial risks.
gewerbeversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Which risks does business insurance cover?
gewerbeversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Is business insurance required by law?
gewerbeversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: How is the premium for business insurance calculated?
gewerbeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Business insurance is insurance tailored specifically to the needs of companies and traders. It comprises various policies that address the specific risks of running a business, such as business liability insurance, contents (inventory) insurance, business interruption insurance and vehicle fleet insurance.
gewerbeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: The exact risks covered by business insurance depend on the policies chosen and the individual needs of the company. It can offer protection against damage caused by fire, burglary, liability claims, business interruptions, natural disasters and much more.
gewerbeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: In most countries there is no legal obligation to take out business insurance. However, certain types of insurance, such as business liability insurance, may be mandatory in some industries or for certain activities.
gewerbeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: The premium for business insurance is usually calculated on the basis of various factors, such as the type and size of the company, turnover, industry, location, sums insured and individual risk profile. An insurance agent or broker can help you calculate the premium.

grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.Name: Property Owner's Liability Insurance
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.Headline: Security for property owners
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.Einleitung Hero: Discover the advantages of property owner's liability insurance, which protects you if someone is injured on your property and you are held liable for any claims for damages.
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.Thema: Safe properties, worry-free owners: our cover
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.Thema Richtext: As a property owner, you have certain responsibilities and face certain risks. Property owner's liability insurance is essential to protect you against third-party liability claims arising from injuries or damage on your property. It covers the costs of claims for damages and, if necessary, defends you in court. In addition to property owner's liability insurance, you may also want to consider environmental damage liability insurance to protect yourself against claims for damages resulting from pollution or environmental damage. With comprehensive cover, you minimise potential financial risks and can enjoy your property with greater peace of mind and security.
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 1: What is property owner's liability insurance?
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 2: Which risks does property owner's liability insurance cover?
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 3: Does property owner's liability insurance also apply to rented-out properties?
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 4: Is property owner's liability insurance required by law?
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 1: Property owner's liability insurance protects owners of land and buildings against claims for damages from third parties. It covers personal injury or property damage that may occur on the insured land or in the building.
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 2: Property owner's liability insurance covers damage that may be caused by hazards or defects on the land or in the building, such as slippery floors, falling objects, defective stairs or inadequate safety precautions.
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 3: Yes, property owner's liability insurance also applies to rented-out properties. It protects the owner against claims for damages from tenants or other people on the land or in the building.
grundbesitzerhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 4: In most countries there is no legal obligation to take out property owner's liability insurance. However, in certain cases, such as when letting or using a property commercially, such insurance may be recommended or required by contract. It is important to check the relevant regulations in your country.

haftpflichtversicherung.Name: Personal Liability Insurance
haftpflichtversicherung.Headline: Make sure you are financially protected if damage occurs
haftpflichtversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Discover the advantages of liability insurance, which gives you financial protection if you are held responsible for damage and liable to compensate for it.
haftpflichtversicherung.Thema: Financial security in the event of damage and accidents
haftpflichtversicherung.Thema Richtext: Nobody wants to end up in a situation where they suffer financial loss. But unforeseen events such as fire, burglary, natural disasters or other incidents can happen to anyone. To protect yourself against financial burdens, appropriate insurance cover is essential. Home contents insurance protects your personal belongings and reimburses you for the financial value of your items in the event of a loss. Buildings insurance protects your home and its building fabric. In addition, natural hazards insurance can be a sensible addition to protect you against damage from natural hazards such as flooding or landslides. By choosing the right insurance cover, you ensure financial security in the event of a loss and can sit back and relax.
haftpflichtversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Is liability insurance required by law?
haftpflichtversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Does liability insurance also cover damage to my own property?
haftpflichtversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Liability insurance is important because it protects you against claims for damages from third parties. If you accidentally cause personal injury or property damage, your liability insurance covers the costs of settling the claim.
haftpflichtversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: In many countries, liability insurance is required by law for certain areas, such as operating a motor vehicle. In other cases there is no legal obligation, but taking out liability insurance is still strongly recommended.
haftpflichtversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: No, liability insurance generally only covers damage you cause to other people or their property. To cover damage to your own property, you need a suitable policy such as home contents insurance or buildings insurance.
haftpflichtversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: The territorial scope of liability insurance can vary. Some policies offer worldwide cover, while others only apply within a certain geographical area. It is important to check the policy terms and conditions to find out the exact scope of your liability insurance.

hausratversicherung.Name: Home Contents Insurance
hausratversicherung.Headline: Security for your home and your valuables
hausratversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out more about home contents insurance and buildings insurance, which protect your home and your valuables and safeguard you against financial losses.
hausratversicherung.Thema: Home secure, valuables protected: our insurance solutions
hausratversicherung.Thema Richtext: Your home is a place where you feel safe, and it is important to protect it accordingly. Home contents insurance provides financial protection for the personal belongings in your home. It reimburses you for the financial value of your items in the event of theft, fire, water damage or other insured risks. Buildings insurance protects the fabric of your house against damage caused by fire, storms, burst pipes or hail. With comprehensive cover for your home and your valuables, you can have peace of mind and enjoy your home to the full.
hausratversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Which types of damage are covered by home contents insurance?
hausratversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: How is the value of your home contents determined for insurance purposes?
hausratversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Does home contents insurance also apply outside your own home?
hausratversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Home contents insurance protects your household contents against damage or loss resulting from burglary, theft, fire, water damage and other risks. It generally covers movable items such as furniture, electrical appliances, clothing and valuables.
hausratversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Home contents insurance generally covers damage caused by burglary, theft, fire, water from burst pipes, storms and hail. Depending on the policy, further risks such as natural hazards, power surge damage or bicycle theft may also be covered.
hausratversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: The value of your home contents for insurance purposes is usually determined by estimating the total value of all movable items in the household. It is important to review this value regularly and adjust it if necessary to ensure an adequate sum insured.
hausratversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: The territorial scope of home contents insurance can vary. As a rule, however, cover applies not only in your own home but also outside it, e.g. if your insured belongings are stolen or damaged while you are travelling or in a rented holiday home. It is important to check the policy terms and conditions to find out the exact scope.

kapitallebensversicherung.Name: Endowment Life Insurance
kapitallebensversicherung.Headline: Financial security for your loved ones
kapitallebensversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Make sure your loved ones are financially secure even when you are no longer there. Our insurance solutions give you the protection you need and financial security for the people closest to you.
kapitallebensversicherung.Thema: Financial security for your loved ones: protection and support
kapitallebensversicherung.Thema Richtext: The financial security of your loved ones matters to you, and you want to make sure they are well provided for in the event of your death. Term life insurance offers financial protection for your surviving dependants. In the event of your death, they receive a pre-agreed sum that they can use to meet financial obligations such as ongoing costs, mortgages or education costs. By taking out term life insurance, you make sure your loved ones are financially secure in difficult times and can focus on coping with their loss.
kapitallebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: What are the advantages of endowment life insurance?
kapitallebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Are there any restrictions with endowment life insurance?
kapitallebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Is endowment life insurance suitable for everyone?
kapitallebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Endowment life insurance is a life insurance policy that builds up capital in addition to providing death cover. If the insured person dies, the agreed sum insured is paid out to the beneficiaries. When the policy term ends, the accumulated capital is paid out, including any profit participation (bonuses).
kapitallebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: The advantage of endowment life insurance is that it combines death cover with capital accumulation. It can therefore provide financial protection for surviving dependants while at the same time building up capital for the insured person.
kapitallebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Yes, endowment life insurance comes with certain rules and restrictions. These include, for example, a fixed policy term, regular premium payments and a set rate of interest on the accumulated capital. In addition, there may be costs for administration, taking out the policy and risk cover.
kapitallebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Endowment life insurance can be suitable for people who want both death cover and capital accumulation. It is important to consider your own needs, financial means and appetite for risk before deciding on endowment life insurance.

krankenzusatzversicherung.Name: Supplementary Health Insurance
krankenzusatzversicherung.Headline: Extra protection for your health
krankenzusatzversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Discover the advantages of supplementary health insurance, which gives you additional benefits and security when it comes to your health.
krankenzusatzversicherung.Thema: More protection for your health: our supplementary insurance
krankenzusatzversicherung.Thema Richtext: Supplementary health insurance gives you additional protection for your health and complements your statutory health insurance. With supplementary health insurance, you can cover benefits such as treatment by the head physician, a single or double room in hospital, dentures and dental prosthetics, or alternative therapies. This kind of insurance gives you extended medical benefits and helps ensure you receive the best possible healthcare.
krankenzusatzversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Which benefits are covered by supplementary health insurance?
krankenzusatzversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Does supplementary health insurance make sense for everyone?
krankenzusatzversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Can I take out supplementary health insurance at any time?
krankenzusatzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Supplementary health insurance provides benefits in addition to statutory health insurance. It gives insured persons access to extended medical services, such as specialist treatment, free choice of hospital or treatment by the head physician.
krankenzusatzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: The exact benefits of supplementary health insurance vary depending on the policy. Typically, however, it covers benefits such as dentures and dental prosthetics, glasses and contact lenses, alternative therapies, better hospital accommodation, medicines, preventive check-ups and outpatient treatment.
krankenzusatzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Whether supplementary health insurance makes sense depends on your individual needs and preferences. If you want additional medical benefits beyond the scope of statutory health insurance, supplementary health insurance can be a worthwhile addition.
krankenzusatzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: As a rule, you can take out supplementary health insurance at any time. However, certain pre-existing conditions or current health problems may affect whether you can take out the policy or on what terms. It is advisable to check the conditions and health questions before signing the contract.

oltankversicherung.Name: Heating Oil Tank Insurance
oltankversicherung.Headline: Protection for your oil tank system
oltankversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Discover the advantages of oil tank insurance, which gives you financial protection if your oil tank system is damaged or develops a leak.
oltankversicherung.Thema: Safe oil storage: protection for your oil tank system
oltankversicherung.Thema Richtext: If you own an oil tank system, it is important to insure it properly. Oil tank insurance gives you financial protection in the event of damage to the system or leaking oil. It covers the costs of repairs, clean-up work and environmental damage. This kind of insurance protects you against financial burdens and gives you the reassurance that you are well covered if the worst happens.
oltankversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Which risks does oil tank insurance cover?
oltankversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Is oil tank insurance required by law?
oltankversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Does oil tank insurance also apply to other liquid tanks?
oltankversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Oil tank insurance covers damage caused by leakage or other hazards associated with an oil tank. It provides financial protection against potential costs for clean-up, repair or remediation in the event of oil leaks or damage caused by the oil tank system.
oltankversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Oil tank insurance typically covers damage that may result from the oil tank leaking, damage to the tank or its associated pipework, and environmental damage caused by escaping oil. Depending on the policy, additional benefits such as clean-up costs or the cost of replacing damaged installations may also be included.
oltankversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: In some countries or regions, oil tank insurance may be required by law. This serves to protect both the owner of the oil tank and the environment against possible financial damage. It is important to check the relevant regulations in the country or region concerned.
oltankversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Oil tank insurance is designed specifically for oil tanks. It generally does not automatically cover other liquid tanks, such as tanks for water or chemicals. It is advisable to check the policy terms and conditions to find out the exact scope of cover.

pflegeversicherung.Name: Long-Term Care Insurance
pflegeversicherung.Headline: Financial protection if you need long-term care
pflegeversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out how long-term care insurance offers you and your loved ones financial support if you come to need care.
pflegeversicherung.Thema: Financial security if you need care: our support
pflegeversicherung.Thema Richtext: Long-term care insurance gives you financial support if you come to need care in old age or as a result of illness. It helps you cover the costs of professional care services and so eases the burden on your family. With long-term care insurance, you make sure you are financially protected if you need care and receive the best possible care.
pflegeversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Is long-term care insurance required by law?
pflegeversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Which benefits does long-term care insurance cover?
pflegeversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: How much are long-term care insurance contributions?
pflegeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Long-term care insurance provides financial benefits to cover the costs that arise when someone needs care. It supports people in need of care with the costs of home care, residential (inpatient) care or outpatient care services.
pflegeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: In many countries there is a legal obligation to insure against the risk of needing care – in Germany, for example, through statutory long-term care insurance. How this obligation is regulated can differ from country to country.
pflegeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Long-term care insurance generally covers the benefits needed when someone requires care. These include, for example, the costs of professional care, medical treatment, home care aids, care allowance (Pflegegeld) or the cost of adapting your home.
pflegeversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: The contribution for long-term care insurance varies depending on the country, the provider and individual factors such as the age and state of health of the insured person. In some countries, long-term care insurance contributions are based on income.

private-krankenversicherung.Name: Private Health Insurance (PKV)
private-krankenversicherung.Headline: Tailored protection for your health
private-krankenversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Discover the benefits of private health insurance, individually tailored to you and your needs and offering you comprehensive protection.
private-krankenversicherung.Thema: Your health, our protection: tailored insurance
private-krankenversicherung.Thema Richtext: Private health insurance offers you tailored cover for your health. Unlike statutory health insurance, private health insurance lets you choose individual benefit packages that match your needs and expectations. These include benefits such as free choice of doctor, treatment by the senior consultant, a single or double room in hospital and other additional benefits. With private health insurance, you gain access to high-quality medical care and enjoy comprehensive insurance cover.
private-krankenversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Who can take out private health insurance?
private-krankenversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Which benefits are covered by private health insurance?
private-krankenversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Is private health insurance more expensive than statutory health insurance?
private-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Private health insurance is insurance that provides individual health cover. It gives policyholders access to private medical services, such as choice of doctor or hospital, shorter waiting times and extended benefits compared with statutory health insurance.
private-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: As a rule, people who meet certain requirements can take out private health insurance. These often include a certain level of income or occupational status. Access to private health insurance may be regulated differently depending on the country.
private-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: The benefits of private health insurance vary depending on the contract and individual needs. They can be more extensive than those of statutory health insurance and may cover, for example, the costs of medical treatment, medication, hospital stays, preventive check-ups and alternative therapies.
private-krankenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Private health insurance premiums can be higher than contributions to statutory health insurance. This is because private health insurers offer individual cover and are not based on uniform contribution rates. The costs depend on various factors such as age, state of health and the chosen scope of benefits.

rechtsschutzversicherung.Name: Legal Expenses Insurance
rechtsschutzversicherung.Headline: Protect your rights and interests
rechtsschutzversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out more about legal expenses insurance and how it helps you protect your rights and interests in legal matters and stands up for you.
rechtsschutzversicherung.Thema: Your rights in focus: protection and support
rechtsschutzversicherung.Thema Richtext: It is important to protect your rights and interests in various areas of life. Legal expenses insurance offers you financial protection and legal support if you become involved in a legal dispute. It helps you assert your rights in areas such as employment law, traffic law or tenancy law. With professional liability insurance, you can protect your professional interests. This insurance covers the financial consequences of compensation claims that may arise from your professional activities. By protecting yourself comprehensively, you can make sure that your rights and interests are safeguarded and that you are financially covered in the event of a legal dispute.
rechtsschutzversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Which areas does legal expenses insurance cover?
rechtsschutzversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Are there waiting periods or excesses with legal expenses insurance?
rechtsschutzversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Can I freely choose a lawyer if I have legal expenses insurance?
rechtsschutzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Legal expenses insurance is insurance that covers the costs of legal disputes and litigation. It provides financial support for lawyers' fees, court fees and other expenses relating to legal matters.
rechtsschutzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Legal expenses insurance can cover various areas, such as employment law, traffic law, tenancy law, family law and criminal law. Depending on the contract, certain areas of law may be excluded or restricted.
rechtsschutzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Yes, many legal expenses insurance policies have waiting periods, i.e. certain benefits are only granted once a specific period has elapsed. An excess may also be agreed, i.e. the policyholder bears part of the costs themselves.
rechtsschutzversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: In most cases, the policyholder can choose a lawyer of their choice. However, it is advisable to check the policy terms beforehand, as some insurers require the use of certain lawyer networks or partner firms.

reiseversicherung.Name: Travel Insurance
reiseversicherung.Headline: Enjoy your trip with worry-free protection
reiseversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Discover the benefits of travel insurance, which gives you security during your trip and protection against unforeseen events such as having to cut your trip short, illness or lost luggage.
reiseversicherung.Thema: Relaxed travels: worry-free on the road with our travel cover
reiseversicherung.Thema Richtext: Travelling allows us to discover new places and collect precious memories. To make sure you can enjoy your trip to the full, worry-free insurance cover is essential. Travel insurance offers comprehensive protection during your travels. This includes trip cancellation insurance, which reimburses your costs if you have to cancel your trip, trip interruption insurance, which covers costs if your trip is cut short, and travel health insurance, which pays for medical costs abroad. Luggage insurance also offers financial protection if your luggage is lost or damaged. With comprehensive travel cover, you can sit back, relax and enjoy your trip without a care.
reiseversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Which benefits does travel insurance cover?
reiseversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: When should I take out travel insurance?
reiseversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Travel insurance is insurance specifically tailored to the needs of travellers. It can include various benefits, such as trip cancellation insurance, travel health insurance, luggage insurance and travel accident insurance.
reiseversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: The exact benefits of travel insurance can vary depending on the contract. In general, however, it covers costs arising from unforeseen events during the trip, such as cancellation of the trip, medical emergencies, lost luggage or interruption of the trip.
reiseversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Travel insurance is not required by law, but it can be advisable in order to cover the financial risks associated with travelling. Travel insurance can be particularly worthwhile for expensive trips, long-haul trips or trips with a higher level of risk.
reiseversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: It is advisable to take out travel insurance as early as possible, ideally straight after booking your trip. That way, you are protected from the outset against possible cancellation costs or other unforeseen events.

rentenversicherung.Name: Pension Insurance
rentenversicherung.Headline: Secure a stable pension
rentenversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out how pension insurance can help you secure a stable source of income for your retirement.
rentenversicherung.Thema: A stable pension for your future: our insurance solutions
rentenversicherung.Thema Richtext: A stable pension is an important goal you want to achieve. Pension insurance gives you the opportunity to receive regular pension payments in retirement. You pay contributions into the pension insurance during your working life and in return receive a lifelong pension. This kind of insurance enables you to ensure your financial security in old age and maintain the standard of living you want.
rentenversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Are there different types of pension insurance?
rentenversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: What risks are involved in pension insurance?
rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Pension insurance is a form of retirement provision in which regular contributions are paid in order to receive a monthly pension in retirement. Pension insurance can be offered both by private insurance companies and by state pension insurance providers.
rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: With pension insurance, the policyholder pays regular contributions. These contributions are accumulated and earn interest so that a lifelong pension can be paid out at retirement age. The amount of the pension depends on various factors, such as the amount of contributions paid, the term of the policy and the agreed form of pension.
rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Yes, there are different types of pension insurance. These include private pension insurance, occupational pension schemes, statutory pension insurance and state-subsidised pension products such as the Riester pension or the basic pension (Basisrente). Each type of pension insurance has different features and advantages.
rentenversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Pension insurance can involve various risks, such as longevity risk (the pension is not enough to last your entire lifetime), inflation risk (loss of purchasing power due to rising prices) and investment risks (e.g. losses in value when capital markets are weak). It is important to take these risks into account when choosing and planning pension insurance.

riesterrente.Name: Riester Pension
riesterrente.Headline: State-subsidised retirement provision
riesterrente.Einleitung Hero: Find out about state-subsidised retirement savings schemes such as the Riester pension, which offers you financial benefits and support in saving for retirement.
riesterrente.Thema: State support for your retirement provision: our offers
riesterrente.Thema Richtext: State-subsidised retirement provision gives you a way to secure your pension while benefiting from state allowances and tax advantages. The best-known forms of state-subsidised retirement provision are the Riester pension and the basic pension (Basisrente). The Riester pension lets you receive state allowances and tax advantages, while the basic pension enjoys tax benefits. By investing in state-subsidised retirement provision, you create a solid financial foundation for your retirement.
riesterrente.FAQ Frage 2: What are the advantages of the Riester pension?
riesterrente.FAQ Frage 3: Who can benefit from the Riester pension?
riesterrente.FAQ Frage 4: Are there any restrictions on the Riester pension?
riesterrente.FAQ Antwort 1: The Riester pension is a state-subsidised private pension scheme in Germany. It enables policyholders to build up capital for their later retirement income through their own contributions and state allowances. The Riester pension is aimed in particular at employees and certain other groups of people.
riesterrente.FAQ Antwort 2: The Riester pension offers several advantages. Firstly, policyholders receive state allowances that give their retirement savings an extra boost. Secondly, the contributions are tax-deductible. In addition, there are guaranteed minimum benefits and a lifelong pension once you retire.
riesterrente.FAQ Antwort 3: Those who can benefit from the Riester pension include, in particular, employees, civil servants, self-employed people with income subject to compulsory pension insurance and certain groups such as people doing military or civilian service, students with compulsory insurance or low earners. The exact requirements vary depending on the country and legislation.
riesterrente.FAQ Antwort 4: Yes, there are certain rules and restrictions for the Riester pension. These include, for example, certain minimum contributions, a start-of-pension phase set by the state, the requirement to pay your own contributions regularly and the obligation to pay tax on the Riester pension benefits in retirement.

risikolebensversicherung.Name: Term Life Insurance
risikolebensversicherung.Headline: Protection for your loved ones
risikolebensversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out about term life insurance and how it provides financial security for your loved ones should anything happen to you.
risikolebensversicherung.Thema: Providing for your loved ones: protection and security
risikolebensversicherung.Thema Richtext: Your family and loved ones matter to you, and it is essential to protect them properly. Term life insurance provides financial security in the event of your death. If you die, it pays out a pre-agreed sum to your surviving dependants to help them maintain their usual standard of living and cushion financial burdens. In addition, you can also consider a survivors' pension to provide your loved ones with regular financial support. With the right insurance cover, you ensure your loved ones' financial security and give them the protection they need in difficult times.
risikolebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Who is term life insurance worthwhile for?
risikolebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: How is the sum insured determined for term life insurance?
risikolebensversicherung.FAQ Frage 4: Are term life insurance premiums tax-deductible?
risikolebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Term life insurance is insurance that provides financial security for surviving dependants if the insured person dies during the term of the policy. In the event of death, it pays out a previously agreed sum insured to the named beneficiaries.
risikolebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Term life insurance is particularly worthwhile for people on whose income others depend financially and whose surviving dependants should be financially secure if they die. These might be, for example, families with children or people with major financial commitments such as mortgages.
risikolebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: The sum insured for term life insurance depends on individual needs and financial commitments. It is advisable to take into account the financial needs of your surviving dependants, such as debts, ongoing costs and education costs.
risikolebensversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: In many countries, term life insurance premiums are not tax-deductible. It is advisable to check the tax rules of the country concerned to obtain precise information about their tax treatment.

schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.Name: Critical Illness Insurance
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.Headline: Financial support in the event of serious illness
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.Einleitung Hero: Find out how critical illness insurance gives you financial support if you are affected by a serious illness.
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.Thema: Support with serious illness: financial protection in difficult times
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.Thema Richtext: Serious illnesses such as cancer, heart attack or stroke can not only be an enormous physical and emotional burden but also have financial consequences. Critical illness insurance offers you financial support if you are affected by a serious illness. If you are diagnosed, it pays out a pre-agreed sum that you can use to cover medical costs or additional expenses, or to fund time off work. With this kind of insurance, you can make sure you are financially secure in difficult times and can focus fully on your recovery.
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.FAQ Frage 2: Which illnesses are covered by critical illness insurance?
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Who is critical illness insurance worthwhile for?
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.FAQ Frage 4: What is the difference between critical illness insurance and occupational disability insurance?
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Critical illness insurance, also known as dread disease insurance, is insurance that provides a financial benefit if the insured person contracts a specific serious illness. This insurance pays out a previously agreed sum insured, regardless of the actual treatment costs.
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: The illnesses covered can vary depending on the insurance contract. Typically, however, they include serious conditions such as cancer, heart attack, stroke, kidney failure or Parkinson's disease. It is important to check the exact terms and exclusions in the insurance contract.
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: Critical illness insurance can be worthwhile for anyone who wants to protect themselves against the financial consequences of serious illness. Especially for people who cannot or do not want to take out comprehensive occupational disability insurance, critical illness insurance can be a useful addition.
schwere-krankheiten-versicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: Occupational disability insurance covers the loss of your ability to work in your own occupation, whereas critical illness insurance provides a financial benefit if the insured person contracts a specific serious illness. The sum insured under critical illness insurance is paid regardless of occupation and actual loss of income.

tierhalterhaftpflicht.Name: Pet Owner Liability Insurance
tierhalterhaftpflicht.Headline: Security for you and your furry friends
tierhalterhaftpflicht.Einleitung Hero: Find out about pet owner liability insurance and how it gives you peace of mind when it comes to possible damage or injuries that your pets may cause.
tierhalterhaftpflicht.Thema: Protected together: security for you and your pets
tierhalterhaftpflicht.Thema Richtext: Your pets are an important part of your family and deserve the best possible protection too. Liability insurance for pets offers you financial protection if your pet causes damage or injures people. It covers third-party compensation claims and protects you from financial burdens. In addition to liability insurance, you can also consider pet health insurance. It covers vet bills if your pet becomes ill or injured. With the right insurance cover, you ensure the safety of your furry friends and minimise the financial risks associated with them.
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 1: What is pet owner liability insurance?
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 2: Is pet owner liability insurance required by law?
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 3: Which damage is covered by pet owner liability insurance?
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Frage 4: Does pet owner liability insurance also apply abroad?
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 1: Pet owner liability insurance is insurance that covers damage caused by a pet. It protects the pet owner against third-party compensation claims that may arise, for example, from injuries or property damage.
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 2: In some countries or German federal states, pet owner liability insurance may be required by law, especially for certain pets such as dogs. It is important to check the relevant regulations of the country or region concerned.
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 3: Pet owner liability insurance generally covers personal injury and property damage caused by the insured pet. This can include, for example, bite injuries, damage to other people's property or accidents.
tierhalterhaftpflicht.FAQ Antwort 4: The territorial scope of pet owner liability insurance can vary. Some policies also offer cover abroad, while others may only be valid within your home country. It is important to check the policy terms to find out the exact scope of cover.

unfallversicherung.Name: Accident Insurance
unfallversicherung.Headline: Protection against the unexpected
unfallversicherung.Einleitung Hero: Learn how accident insurance provides financial security for you and your family if you are injured in an accident and unforeseen costs arise as a result.
unfallversicherung.Thema: Preparing for the unexpected: financial protection for every eventuality
unfallversicherung.Thema Richtext: Life is full of unpredictable events, so it is important to be prepared for such situations. Private accident insurance offers financial support in the event of accidental injury. It provides you with benefits such as disability payments, an accident pension or even cosmetic surgery. Term life insurance protects your loved ones should anything happen to you. It offers financial support for your surviving dependants and can help them maintain their usual standard of living. By protecting yourself against unforeseen events, you create financial security for yourself and your loved ones and can look to the future with peace of mind.
unfallversicherung.FAQ Frage 2: What is the difference between accident insurance and health insurance?
unfallversicherung.FAQ Frage 3: Which benefits are included in accident insurance?
unfallversicherung.FAQ Antwort 1: Accident insurance is insurance that provides financial benefits if the insured person suffers physical harm as a result of an accident. It can offer financial support for medical treatment, rehabilitation, disability or in the event of death.
unfallversicherung.FAQ Antwort 2: Accident insurance specifically covers the consequences of accidents, whereas health insurance covers the costs of medical treatment in general, regardless of whether it is caused by an accident or an illness.
unfallversicherung.FAQ Antwort 3: The benefits of accident insurance can vary depending on the contract. They may include, among other things, disability benefits, daily hospital allowance, recovery allowance, an accident pension or death benefits.
unfallversicherung.FAQ Antwort 4: The territorial scope of accident insurance can differ. Some policies offer worldwide cover, while others only apply within a certain geographical area. It is important to check the policy terms to find out the exact scope of your accident insurance.
